source_title: EcoDataCenter breaks ground on mega campus in Borlänge
evidence_excerpt: EcoDataCenter says construction has started at Kvarnsveden and the first data center is scheduled for early 2027.
notes: Primary source. Supports under-construction status and 600 MW full campus potential.

source_title: EcoDataCenter breaks ground on mega campus in Borlänge
evidence_excerpt: At launch EcoDataCenter 2 in Borlänge will have access to 250 MW, with potential to scale to 600 MW.
notes: Primary source for phase 1 and full-campus scale.

source_title: Mistral AI and EcoDataCenter Partner to Build AI-focused Data Center in Sweden
evidence_excerpt: Mistral AI and EcoDataCenter announced a strategic long-term investment of EUR 1.2 billion to build an AI-focused data center at EcoDataCenter's Borlänge site, scheduled to open in 2027.
notes: Primary source. Supports committed partnership and 2027 timing but does not state the 23 MW capacity.

source_title: AI-bolaget Mistral investerar 13 miljarder i datacenter i Borlänge
evidence_excerpt: Voister reports Arthur Mensch saying Mistral will build 23 MW of capacity and wants to expand further in Sweden.
notes: Secondary source citing Dagens Industri interview for the 23 MW figure.

source_title: Klart idag Google får bygga datacenter i Dalarna
evidence_excerpt: Computer Sweden reports the court permit covers a data center with backup generation installations totalling up to 1,500 MWth input power.
notes: Secondary source citing the court decision. Supports treating the 1,500 MW as backup-power capacity rather than IT load.

source_title: Google får miljötillstånd för etablering i Horndal
evidence_excerpt: SVT reports Google had not made a business decision to build and that the permit required activity to start within ten years.
notes: Secondary source. Supports permitted/no-investment-decision interpretation and 2031 permit deadline.

source_title: Nu har Google beviljats bygglov för ett datacenter i Horndal
evidence_excerpt: SVT reports Google has received a building permit, preparatory groundworks are continuing, and Google says no formal decision to build has been taken.
notes: Updates Google Horndal notes with building-permit progress while preserving no-investment-decision classification.
